jobs.instructions: Speak in clear Modern Standard Arabic as a warm, composed preschool teacher addressing a small class. Use a natural feminine speaking voice in a comfortable middle register, with a clear steady tone and small pitch variations. Sound attentive and gently encouraging, with understated expression. Use ordinary classroom speech with clear word beginnings and clean endings. Keep consonants clear and long vowels accurate and evenly timed, without stretching them for expression. Avoid breathiness, whispering, vocal fry and sing-song pitch glides. Read only the supplied Arabic item exactly once, as teaching speech. Preserve its written short and long vowels. Do not add a letter name or a lead-in. No introduction, numbers, commentary, music or additional sounds. Read once in a smooth, composed classroom voice. End cleanly, without repetition or an expressive trailing sound. This is a complete teaching example beginning with short a, followed by a doubled consonant. Preserve the consonant closure and then release into the written short final vowel; do not replace the final vowel with eh or ay, lengthen it, or add another consonant.
